announcement.quote: The Board of Trustees of each of the Acquiring Funds, listed below, announces the proposed reorganization of several closed-end investment companies advised by First Trust Advisors, L.P. into the respective Acquiring Funds (“Reorganizations”).

deals.notes: ACP shareholder special meeting to approve the share issuance was set for 2024-01-19 (PRE 14A and DEF 14A); each Reorganization was stated not to be contingent on the other. No excerpt states the result of any vote or whether the reorganization closed. The 2024-2025 DEF 14A and 8-K excerpts (compact) show no outcome language. The press release table gives tickers only, no exchange, so listing of FSD is not settled by the excerpts.
